title.narrative: Pastoralist Voices: From Dialogue to Action for Sustainable Rangelands

description.narrative: This RP supports the objectives of the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists (IYRP) 2026 by promoting inclusive dialogue, knowledge exchange, and collaborative action to strengthen pastoralist livelihoods and sustainable rangeland management in Eastern Africa. Through multi-stakeholder consultations, the initiative will amplify pastoralist voices, document Indigenous and Local Knowledge (ILK), and foster partnerships among communities, governments, researchers, and development partners. The project will develop a stakeholder-driven action plan and knowledge products to inform policy and investment decisions. By recognizing pastoralists as key stewards of rangelands, the initiative contributes to biodiversity conservation, climate resilience, ecosystem restoration, sustainable livelihoods, and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals across Eastern Africa's rangeland landscapes
